annotations.exact_quote: Semi-Supervised Maximum Margin Clustering with Pairwise Constraints
annotations.reason_zh: 标题明确为半监督最大间隔聚类，摘要说明使用成对约束指导聚类，符合结合有限监督信息/成对约束与未标注样本的半监督学习设定。

annotations.exact_quote: Based on the maximum margin idea in MMC, we propose a set of effective loss functions for discouraging the violation of given pairwise constraints.
annotations.reason_zh: 以成对关系约束替代完整实例级类别标签来指导聚类，监督不完整且不精确，属于弱监督条件。
